name: Apollo Lunar Module attitude controller assembly
view: the LM ACA (rotation hand controller) from the left, as the standing commander sees it; forward is left: the pistol grip with its trigger switch under the index finger, on the housing at the commander's right hand
origin: JoyPro's own vector drawing: the grip and housing reconstructed from the public Apollo Lunar Module descriptions (LM familiarization manual overview, Apollo Lunar Surface Journal) and public museum photos looked at for proportions; not traced from a photo.
